prompt: A redesign brief says 'research shows parents care most about campus facilities', but the only source is a stakeholder workshop note from last year. Decide how the agent should record and use this claim before redesigning the homepage.
expected_outcomes: Stakeholder input is not relabeled as user research
The design can proceed with the claim marked as an assumption or hypothesis
A validation/research path is proposed if the decision is material
must_not: Discard the claim without recording why
